features.title: Intelligent, Transparent, Human-Centered Healthcare
features.subtitle: Everything you need to discover trusted doctors, compare nearby hospitals, and book appointments with total confidence.
features.aiDesc: Describe symptoms in plain language to find relevant specialties without medical jargon.
features.nearbyDesc: Haversine geo-distance calculation to discover the closest qualified healthcare centers.
features.availabilityDesc: Real-time doctor schedules, transparent consultation slots, and immediate booking.
features.reviewsDesc: Real feedback from completed patient visits to help you make informed decisions.
features.multilingualDesc: Available in English, தமிழ் (Tamil), and हिन्दी (Hindi) with rural-friendly high-contrast UI.
features.bookingDesc: Book instantly with automated confirmations and no double-booking guarantee.

howItWorks.title: How MediConnect Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Four simple, transparent steps from healthcare query to confirmed consultation.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Describe what healthcare help you are looking for in your own words or local language.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our AI identifies potentially relevant specialties and matches licensed hospitals providing that care.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Review proximity, patient ratings, clinical experience, and live open consultation slots.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Choose your preferred time slot, receive booking confirmation, and track your appointment.

disclaimer.safetyText: MediConnect provides informational recommendations to help users discover healthcare professionals and facilities. It does NOT provide medical diagnosis or treatment advice. The final healthcare decision belongs to the patient and qualified healthcare professionals.
disclaimer.emergencyText: If you are experiencing a medical emergency or severe symptoms, please immediately contact local emergency services (112 / 108) or visit the nearest emergency department.
